title: Algeria Precipitation (CHIRPS v3.0), 1981–present: national, wilaya and commune
title_fr: Précipitations en Algérie (CHIRPS v3.0) : national, wilayas et communes
description: Monthly (1981-01 to 2025-02) and annual (1981–2024) precipitation for Algeria at 0.05° (≈5.5 km), with 1991–2020 normals, anomalies and trend statistics, aggregated to Algeria's 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes. Prepared by AEO from CHIRPS v3.0.
purpose: The reference AEO product: an Algeria-ready precipitation record for drought monitoring, agricultural seasons and climate analysis at national, wilaya and commune levels.

spatial_extent.description: Algeria (AEO boundaries 2026-11-20). Rasters cover the cells touching Algeria; statistics for 1 country, 69 wilayas, 1,541 communes.

temporal_extent.frequency: monthly; annual totals for complete years
temporal_extent.description: Monthly 1981-01 to 2025-02; annual totals 1981–2024 (complete calendar years only). Reference period 1991–2020.

variables.name: precip_mm
variables.description: Precipitation total for the month or calendar year (area-weighted mean depth for units)

variables.name: normal_1991_2020_mm
variables.description: Mean of the same period over 1991–2020

variables.name: anomaly_mm / anomaly_pct
variables.description: Departure from the 1991–2020 normal; % not computed where the normal is below 1 mm

variables.name: trend_*
variables.description: Theil–Sen slope with 95 % Sen interval; Mann–Kendall p (Yue–Wang correction when lag-1 autocorrelation is significant)

variables.name: statistical_support
variables.description: adequate (≥ 4 effective cells), limited (1–4), very limited (< 1)

processing: Monthly CHIRPS v3.0 final data for the Algeria window, taken for v1.0.0 from the official CHC yearly NetCDF files (local copy, file date 2025; identical to the server COGs for all 26 months compared) because the CHC data server was unreachable; QC (complete series, no negative values, stable mask); annual totals for complete years; 1991–2020 normals and anomalies; area-weighted zonal means using cell coverage fractions (10×10 supersampling) × geodesic cell area, with wilaya and national weights as unions of commune weights; Theil–Sen / Mann–Kendall trends; export to COG, CSV, Parquet and JSON with SHA-256 manifest. Full method: /docs/method-precipitation/.
validation: Automated checks (tests/python/test_precip_product.py): coverage of every cell inside Algeria, CRS/resolution/no-data, complete series, value ranges, anomaly consistency, annual = sum of months, national mean = area-weighted mean of wilaya means, file checksums. No independent validation against Algerian station data by AEO; see the CHIRPS v3.0 paper for the provider's evaluation.
limitations: Satellite–gauge estimate: few gauges in the Sahara and high plateaus; convective and orographic rainfall in the Tell and Atlas is uncertain.
Relative anomalies are unstable where the normal is small (most of the Sahara).
Commune values describe the commune area at ≈5.5 km resolution; many Tell communes cover fewer than 4 grid cells (see support class).
CHIRPS v3.0 is wetter than v2.0 (gauge undercatch correction); do not mix versions.
The national mean is dominated by the dry south and is not representative of the agricultural north.
